trust_decision.summary: Document-supplied w:style/@w:type must not select a style map other than paragraph/character/table/numbering; otherwise styleSet resolves to Object.prototype and styleSet[styleId]=style writes a global key (NEWS: used to flip externalFileAccess, which gates reading external linked images). Decided in readStylesXml. NOTE: the pinned commit IS the core fix commit, so this decision is already enforced at the pin.

landing_point.why: Advisory says 'when reading the styles defined in a document'; readStylesXml is the only styles parser.

fix_sites.entry_point: mammoth.convertToHtml / convertToMarkdown / extractRawText -> docx-reader readStylesFromZipFile (lib/docx/docx-reader.js:214-219); ALREADY APPLIED AT PIN
options.styleMap or document-embedded style map (lib/index.js:37-38, lib/options-reader.js:78-79)
every XML part read via office-xml-reader

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/xml/reader.js:45 (generic XML attribute map), plus lib/document-to-html.js:45 (converter options); both hardened by 2888fa1 but neither is a global-pollution write at the pin

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Core switch fix is already in the tree and its regression test passes; the remaining {} maps are one-level writes where '__proto__' only reparents a local object, so a solver can argue they are not prototype pollution at all.
